summary.text: Patrick Bowersox is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Sydney Batch (D) and Shirley Johnson (R) are also running.
He was also the Libertarian candidate for District 17 in 2022 and 2024, losing both general elections to Batch.
